title: iPhone free for 5 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 5 min (since 13:49Z; released by art-day2-day5-clips (process hold ended)). The limit is 5 min.
Console steps for the phone: C-152 (owner lead; its console step for the phone is posted, not started).
What unblocks it: the next owner takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).
